top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a mature, independently replicated discovery arc (incretin physiology, proglucagon processing and receptor biology, identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide) that led to therapies with large randomised-trial benefit in glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. A citation framed around physiology and the active peptide makes the three-name allocation defensible. The residual weakness is attribution (Knudsen's analogue programme; Mojsov's priority relative to Habener, unverifiable from the supplied files), which affects credit and not merit or maturity, so it does not justify no award.
